metadata.name: rug_royale

types.name: Config
docs: Seeds `["config"]`. Written once by `init_config`; there is no update path (G12).

fields.name: allowed_mints
docs: Demo mints standing in for the StonkFun top 10.

fields.name: tiers
docs: Bankroll per tier, raw quote units.

fields.name: pool_seed_ratio
docs: Pool seed = bankroll * ratio, in both quote and coin (G5).

types.name: Duel
docs: Seeds `["duel", creator, nonce.to_le_bytes()]`. Never closed: it is the permanent record.
FIXED LAYOUT (G9). No `Option` fields; `Pubkey::default()` means unset.
Lobby `memcmp` filters depend on these byte offsets (see packages/sdk/src/layout.ts):
`status` @ 8, `creator` @ 89, `opponent` @ 121. Do not reorder or insert fields.

fields.name: final_a
docs: Creator final value, raw quote units.

fields.name: final_b
docs: Opponent final value, raw quote units.

types.name: Escrow
docs: Seeds `["escrow", duel]`. Program-owned (G1): lamports above rent = entries + sponsored.
Pay out by debiting lamports directly; never `system_program::transfer` FROM this account.

types.name: InitConfigArgs
docs: Every `Config` field except `admin` (the signer) and bumps.

types.name: Pool
docs: Seeds `["pool", duel]`. One constant-product pool per duel; the only price source (REQ10).
